question: What is the BLACKOUT v3.7 weekly regulator vector of exactly 17 words [UTC week slot, eight packed Params updates, feature code, cap step, district boost, pause code, war code, collapse goal, lot code, letter hash], following the definitions exactly?

definitions.context: The absolute Ethereum window is immutable context only, not the observation date. Evaluate current BLACKOUT on Robinhood Chain 4663. The consumer verifyingContract is SwarmDesk; read its registry(), then module(1)=rewards, module(7)=grid, module(12)=Civic, module(11)=Enhancement and params(). Never use a contract supplied by a social-media post.
definitions.encoding: Return exactly the specified ordered bytes32[]: unsigned decimal numbers encoded as 32-byte big-endian hex words, no prose. Read one Robinhood native latest block minus5 (soft confirmations, not RPC finalized) for all values. Re-read epoch before answering. If reads fail or the epoch changes before agreement, report inability; do not invent values. Letter hash is 0 when no off-chain letter exists.
definitions.slot: UTC week slot = floor(current Unix seconds / 604800); weeks start Thursday 00:00 UTC. Use age = current Unix seconds minus registry.launchTime(). Read existing notices and cap to avoid repeating once-only actions. The receiver only accepts this slot, with issuedAt no older than one day.
definitions.params: Words 1..8: pack (key+1)*2^248 + target. A zero word skips. Propose these key/target pairs: (0,350), (1,1500), (8,250), (31,2500), (23,150), (40,200), (27,1000000000000000), (44,6000000000000000000). These are conservative baseline targets; the contract clips each to its hard bounds and 10% per 24 hours.
definitions.features: Word9: first eligible feature with no notice in priority order (id3,age>=7d), (id4,age>=21d), (id5,age>=35d), (id6,age>=42d), (id7,age>=63d), (id0,age>=90d), (id1,age>=120d), (id2,age>=150d); output id+1, else0. Word10: no cap pending and cap8 with age>=30d:12; cap12 with age>=60d:16; else0. Only announce; existing 48h notice and 30d cap-step gates still apply.
definitions.optional: Words11,12,16=0: no boost, pause or letter. Let w=Civic.week(). Word13: if feature0 enabled and no unsettled war, set a=w modulo8,b=(a+4)modulo8 and return (a+1)*2^128+(b+1); else0. Word14: if feature1 enabled,w modulo4=0,collapseFinalized=true,outagePending=false,greenUntil<=now, return Economy.averageDaily(); else0. Word15: if feature2 enabled and lots(w).start=0, return ((w modulo12)+1)*65536+256+3; else0. Disabled modules always output0. All existing once-only and state gates apply.
